summary: Keep disabled/off Cart projections within the same evidence-based transport confirmation contract and report submission rather than observed device-off state.

scoped_evidence.approved_architecture_reference: Existing Matrix-owned AUX/DDP release path. MQTT publish acceptance and retained WLED MQTT online are not correlated proof of application of a particular Cart projection.
scoped_evidence.affected_subsystem: Offline staged Foundation adapter and reconciliation status serialization only. No live Supabase, MQTT, Matrix, AUX, Cloudflare, or device changes.
scoped_evidence.rollback_reference: Revert adapter, reconcile, test, and evidence files to branch base 2b41a94eeeffd1abe610658e8033ab68cc14d3a1; no live deployment occurred.
evidence_sources: AKS Delta Inbox row 1450: exact read-only live project/function versions and revision-123 mismatch; no live writes.
findings: Established fact: pinned WLED 16.0.1 publishes retained MQTT status=online on connection lifecycle; this is not a revision-correlated response to a Cart projection.
Established fact: previous disabled/off adapter branch set transportConfirmed=true after MQTT publish acceptance without running the liveness observer.
Established fact: reconciliation persisted such responses as online/off, overstating application evidence.

Correction: disabled/off projections now pass through the shared liveness observer and confirmation shape; both enabled and disabled commands are recorded as submitted when transport liveness is observed, and failures remain bounded when it is not.
Inference: truthful submission state prevents the Owner UI/reconciliation layer from implying physical device-off confirmation without a correlated device observation.
tests: Disabled projection with observed liveness: classify as submitted.
Disabled projection without observed liveness: preserve mqtt_publish_accepted_status_not_observed failure.
Governance/control plane remains PHASE2_INTEGRATING/T4; live mutation remains false.
scoped_evidence.validation_limit: Deno and tsc are unavailable, so no Deno typecheck is claimed. No deployment, remote database write, device command, or live behavior validation occurred.
